recommendations.description: Top 10 instance recommendations ranked cheapest to most expensive (rank 1 = best value).

api_name.description: EC2 API instance type name (e.g. m7a.4xlarge).

physical_processor.description: CPU brand/model string from the catalog.

memory_gib.description: Instance memory string from the catalog (e.g. '32 GiB').

gpus.description: Number of GPUs (0 for CPU-only instances).

on_demand_hourly.description: On-demand Linux price in USD per hour.

generation.description: Whether this is a current or previous generation instance.

notes.description: Brief rationale: why this instance fits, AMD/SIMD notes, trade-offs.
